projectDescription: ReclaimLLM (RCLM) is an AI session capture and observability platform that records, indexes, and governs LLM interactions across every tool, provider, and team.
keyFeatures: Native hooks for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Codex CLI capturing full session data including file diffs
Local API proxy (rclm-proxy) that captures all LLM API traffic without code changes
Chrome browser extension capturing ChatGPT, Claude.ai, and Gemini sessions
Enterprise LLM Gateway with team-scoped keys and provider policy controls
Hybrid semantic + keyword search across all providers and sessions
AI-generated session titles, summaries, tags, and categorization
Encrypted raw session storage with downloadable recovery keys
MCP server for in-editor session recall (Claude, Cursor, Codex)
Session sharing via expiring, revocable per-recipient links
Sensitive data detection and local redaction before upload
Org-wide usage analytics with team and cost attribution
Context compression to reduce token costs in agentic sessions
publicApiSurface: MCP tools: search_sessions, search_by_filename, get_session, summarize_session, list_projects
